## Goal
The log and the audit events are meant to hold only ids, enums and counts. The exposure scan logs broker ids and exception class names (`engine/exposure.py:440-453`, `670-690`), `monitor` logs and reports plain text details (`monitor.py:133-138`, `197-212`), and the matcher scores listings. Tests only: run `scan_exposure` with a fake fetcher serving a page that shows the fake person's sentinel name, city and phone, run `monitor.run_monitor` with a fake requester, run `matcher.score_all`, all with `caplog` at DEBUG for the `freemyid` logger tree, then search every log record (message and args), every stored `Event.detail`, every `BrokerHealth.detail`/`page` and the monitor/1 document for the sentinels. A hit is a finding with file:line and a strict xfail.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. After a fake scan of 5 sites (two with the person's listing, one failing with an exception whose text contains a sentinel), no log record text, no `Event.detail` JSON and no `ExposureResult.explanation` line contains the sentinel name, city, street, phone, email or listing URL query string.
2. The failing site is logged by exception class name only (`log.warning(... type(e).__name__)`), never by message (assert the sentinel inside the exception message is absent).
3. `run_monitor` output (`monitor/1`) contains no query strings in `page` (`monitor.py:215-218`) and no page text in `detail`; a fake page body with a sentinel never appears in the document or the logs.
4. `matcher.score_all` and `to_listing` produce `Listing.match_reasons` made of signal names only (no values).
5. Log records at INFO and above for the whole flow are also free of the broker's search URL with the person's name (the URL carries the name by design).
6. Offline: injected fake fetcher and requester; sockets blocked.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
